title: Public method and corrections library
summary: Publish durable evidence, authority, longitudinal, comparison, revision, correction, and launch-governance methods.
record_scope: Public method and corrections library records governed by the stated publication boundaries.
publication_boundaries: Alternative official-source discovery expands the review shelf; it does not by itself admit evidence or answer a mission.
Calendar-bound checks remain unoperated until their lawful date, and shared-date gates retain separate identities, decisions, and receipts.
No project stage, place state, longitudinal observation, comparison verdict, outcome, score, rank, causal finding, recommendation, owner decision, or public-launch authorization is inferred.
A bounded repository result describes the reviewed corpus and search path; it never proves that qualifying evidence does not exist elsewhere.

method_records.title: Evidence admission and adjudication
method_records.purpose: Separate discovery, source checking, relevance screening, admissibility, requirement disposition, and mission conclusion.
rules: A candidate is not admitted evidence.
Every terminal requirement state needs a dated receipt and rationale.
Accepted sources must belong to the reviewed candidate set.
Rejected, inadmissible, and bounded results are legitimate terminal decisions.
A mission conclusion cannot precede all required-evidence dispositions.
method_records.correction_trigger: A source identity, candidate set, decision rationale, reviewer authority, or receipt binding changes.

method_records.title: Authority roles and alternative sources
method_records.purpose: Use alternatives to resolve a missing role without silently lowering the evidence contract.
rules: Name the authority role before selecting the source.
Prefer the controlling regulator, receiver, auditor, operator, or public data steward for the exact claim.
Record an alternative's fit and known limitation.
A portal is a discovery rail unless the exact artifact and version are bound.
A bounded search cannot establish nonexistence.
method_records.correction_trigger: A controlling artifact, version, publisher role, access path, or material limitation changes.

method_records.title: Calendar gates and receipts
method_records.purpose: Operate evidence checks lawfully and preserve independent outcomes.
rules: Never predate a check or receipt.
Create a receipt for Material Change, No Material Change, bounded blocker, or contract-compliant reschedule.
Keep same-date gates independent.
Propagate only the decision supported by the checked artifact.
Record the next exact artifact and date.
method_records.correction_trigger: A gate identity, scheduled date, source, decision, receipt, or propagation target is wrong or incomplete.

method_records.title: Longitudinal compatibility and no-series boundaries
method_records.purpose: Prevent isolated observations and legacy panels from becoming false trends.
rules: Identity, period, measure, method, and denominator must all pass.
Legacy observations never transfer automatically.
Breaks, revisions, and acceptance states remain visible.
Dual review precedes admission.
A zero-series launch must be explicitly disclosed and owner accepted.
method_records.correction_trigger: An observation, definition, denominator, revision, series break, admission, or launch-boundary receipt changes.

method_records.title: Comparison integrity
method_records.purpose: Compare evidence chains without converting non-equivalent measures into a score or rank.
rules: Test identity, stage, geography, period, measure, method, and denominator.
State what is comparable and what is prohibited.
Context only remains controlling until a governed re-review changes it.
No normalization is inferred from similar language.
Publish the decisive evidence that could change the verdict.
method_records.correction_trigger: A compatibility determination, common measure, denominator, verdict, or prohibited comparison changes.

method_records.title: Changefeed and revision lineage
method_records.purpose: Make maintenance legible without treating activity as evidence change.
rules: Every review has a date and scope.
No change is a reportable result.
A material change names its affected records.
Old states and reasons remain recoverable.
Governed decisions invalidate earlier candidate digests.
method_records.correction_trigger: A review date, affected-record list, state transition, prior-state reference, or digest is incomplete.

method_records.title: Corrections, retractions, and contested records
method_records.purpose: Provide a visible path for errors, source revisions, disputes, and withdrawn claims.
rules: Do not silently overwrite a material statement.
Describe the original state, corrected state, reason, date, and affected routes.
Retractions remain discoverable.
Contested evidence keeps the dispute and adjudication authority visible.
Rebuild and revalidate after governed changes.
method_records.correction_trigger: A published statement is materially wrong, misleading, unsupported, superseded, or no longer reproducible.

method_records.title: Launch, repository, hosting, and deployment authority
method_records.purpose: Keep technical readiness distinct from owner acceptance and public availability.
rules: A passing build is not owner acceptance.
A GitHub push is not a hosted deployment.
Hosting is not public-launch authorization.
A custom domain and DNS are separate mutations.
The owner receipt binds the exact commit, build digest, gate snapshot, limitations, and authorization.
method_records.correction_trigger: The commit, digest, gate state, accepted boundary, deployment status, domain, or authorization changes.
